Package org.example.dao

Class PresetConfigDAO

java.lang.Object
org.example.dao.PresetConfigDAO
public class PresetConfigDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for performing CRUD operations on the preset_configs database table in MariaDB.

Allows saving, retrieving, updating, and deleting pre-configured simulation parameters (station capacities, mean arrival rates, and service durations).

Version:
2.0
Author:
Daniel
